ROUTE: Lapwing-235B
REASON: I chose Lapwing because the query is a concrete, single-answer reasoning problem where its higher capability scores (MMLU-Pro 80.3 vs 75.9, GPQA 62.5 vs 56.2) give it a real edge — that benchmark gap was the decisive factor. The politeness/warmth fit was a secondary tiebreaker, not the main reason, since task preferences don't affect output quality per the documentation. Avocet had no capability advantage on this task type, so there was no reason to prefer it.
